_comment: Vectors for VerifyReserveAuth (Go) and verifyReserveAuth (TypeScript), asserted by both sender-auth suites with the same fake checker as depositor-signature-vectors.json (see its _comment for chain, offline and calls). Each vector is an input, {auth: the reserve_auth, expected: the verifier's expectations}, the result the function must return, and every checker call it must make, in order. evm-eoa-verified is the reserve signature in contracts/evm/conformance/direct-deposit-vectors.json, which contracts/evm/source/test/Escrow.directDepositVectors.t.sol runs through the real escrow; every other EVM and Tron signature is made by the same key (keccak256('reserver'), Foundry's makeAddrAndKey) or anvil development key 1 over typed data built with an independent EIP-712 encoder. The Solana reserve hash is the frozen V5 anchor that the Go and TypeScript encoders and the Rust program pin, rebuilt from its byte layout; its signatures are ed25519 over seeds 1..32 (the reserver) and 32 bytes of 2. The signature length bound is the depositor rule's; each suite builds its two length cases from depositor-signature-vectors.json's signatureMaxLength. Edit this file directly.
